storyPoints.title: Dodavatel začíná zpožďovat dodávky
storyPoints.description: Od března dodavatel SUP-001 (velké spotřebiče) výrazně častěji a o více dní zpožďuje dodávky zboží do skladu. Pravděpodobnost zpoždění i jeho maximální délka rostou postupně během března.

storyPoints.title: Vyprodané zásoby, stížnosti a storna
storyPoints.description: Pozdější naskladnění vede k více vyprodaným položkám a čekajícím objednávkám u produktů dodavatele SUP-001. Při stejné pravděpodobnosti stížností a storen tak přibývá stížností, zrušených objednávek a vratek.

expectations.description: Podíl zpožděných dodávek dodavatele SUP-001 vzroste.
expectations.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN CAST(order_date AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2024-01-15' AND DATE '2024-02-29' THEN 'before' ELSE 'after' END AS period, AVG(CASE WHEN is_delayed THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS value FROM main.supplier_delivery WHERE supplier_id = 'SUP-001' AND (CAST(order_date AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2024-01-15' AND DATE '2024-02-29' OR CAST(order_date AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2024-04-01' AND DATE '2024-05-31') GROUP BY 1

expectations.description: Počet čekajících objednávek za den u produktů dodavatele SUP-001 vzroste.
expectations.sql: SELECT period, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / MAX(days) AS value FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN CAST(b."date" AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2024-01-15' AND DATE '2024-02-29' THEN 'before' ELSE 'after' END AS period, CASE WHEN CAST(b."date" AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2024-01-15' AND DATE '2024-02-29' THEN 46 ELSE 61 END AS days FROM main.order_backorder b JOIN main.product p ON p.id = b.product_id WHERE p.supplier_id = 'SUP-001' AND (CAST(b."date" AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2024-01-15' AND DATE '2024-02-29' OR CAST(b."date" AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2024-04-01' AND DATE '2024-05-31')) t GROUP BY period

expectations.description: Počet stížností za den na objednávky produktů dodavatele SUP-001 vzroste.
expectations.sql: SELECT period, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / MAX(days) AS value FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN CAST(c."date" AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2024-01-15' AND DATE '2024-02-29' THEN 'before' ELSE 'after' END AS period, CASE WHEN CAST(c."date" AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2024-01-15' AND DATE '2024-02-29' THEN 46 ELSE 61 END AS days FROM main.complaint c JOIN main.customer_order o ON o.id = c.order_id JOIN main.product p ON p.id = o.product_id WHERE p.supplier_id = 'SUP-001' AND (CAST(c."date" AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2024-01-15' AND DATE '2024-02-29' OR CAST(c."date" AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2024-04-01' AND DATE '2024-05-31')) t GROUP BY period

expectations.description: Počet stornovaných objednávek za den u produktů dodavatele SUP-001 vzroste.
expectations.sql: SELECT period, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / MAX(days) AS value FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN CAST(x."date" AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2024-01-15' AND DATE '2024-02-29' THEN 'before' ELSE 'after' END AS period, CASE WHEN CAST(x."date" AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2024-01-15' AND DATE '2024-02-29' THEN 46 ELSE 61 END AS days FROM main.order_cancellation x JOIN main.customer_order o ON o.id = x.order_id JOIN main.product p ON p.id = o.product_id WHERE p.supplier_id = 'SUP-001' AND (CAST(x."date" AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2024-01-15' AND DATE '2024-02-29' OR CAST(x."date" AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2024-04-01' AND DATE '2024-05-31')) t GROUP BY period

expectations.description: Kontrola: poptávka (počet objednávek za den) po produktech nezasaženého dodavatele SUP-002 zůstává stabilní.
expectations.sql: SELECT period, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / MAX(days) AS value FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN CAST(o."date" AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2024-01-15' AND DATE '2024-02-29' THEN 'before' ELSE 'after' END AS period, CASE WHEN CAST(o."date" AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2024-01-15' AND DATE '2024-02-29' THEN 46 ELSE 61 END AS days FROM main.customer_order o JOIN main.product p ON p.id = o.product_id WHERE p.supplier_id = 'SUP-002' AND (CAST(o."date" AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2024-01-15' AND DATE '2024-02-29' OR CAST(o."date" AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2024-04-01' AND DATE '2024-05-31')) t GROUP BY period
